title: Grilled Australian Blackberry Skewers
description: A sweet and savory outdoor recipe featuring grilled Australian blackberry skewers. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Australian bush tomato sauce (or your favorite BBQ sauce)

instructions: Cut the pork tenderloin into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers with vegetables, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, salt, pepper, honey, and garlic powder.
Brush the mixture onto the pork and vegetables.
Grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
Brush with Australian bush tomato sauce (or your favorite BBQ sauce) during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve hot with grilled blackberries on the side.
Note: If using blackberries, brush with honey and grill for 2-3 minutes, until caramelized.
